title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle vendoring + rke2 Debian Bookworm support
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: add first-class support for Debian 12 (Bookworm) in the on-prem/airgapped installer offline bundles and update vendoring/rollback tooling so customers using RKE2 on Debian can install and upgrade without fetching external artifacts. This PR includes: 1) an offline bundle variant that packages RKE2 runtime and required OS packages for Debian Bookworm with reproducible TUF metadata, 2) updates to the vendoring scripts to fetch and vendor Debian .deb packages and their apt indices into the offline bundle, 3) Helm chart tweaks to detect apt-configured hosts and apply deb-specific preflight checks, 4) upgrade/rollback helper scripts that ensure apt package cache and dpkg state are preserved during rollback, and 5) docs and smoke e2e tests for the new bundle. Changes summary: - Add offline bundle at installer/offline-bundles/rke2/debian-bookworm/ containing rke2 binaries, bundled .debs, apt-mirror metadata, and TUF metadata. - Extend hack/vendoring/generate-offline-bundle.sh to support a debian profile with apt index scraping and mirroring. - Add install-time preflight in charts/redwood-private/templates/preflight.yaml to verify /etc/apt/apt.conf.d expected config on target nodes. - Add rollback hooks in installer/scripts/rollback-dpkg-state.sh and tests in perf-canary/e2e/offline-bundles/debian_bookworm_smoke.sh. - Docs: docs/onprem/offline-bundles.md updated with bookworm-specific notes and upgrade caveats. CI: new smoke step (e2e-offline-bundle-debian) added to the pipeline that runs an L0 bootstrap on a small rke2 VM image; all checks passed on the merge run. Backwards compatibility: bundle naming is additive (no breaking changes). Security: TUF metadata regenerated and signatures produced by the offline CI key; vendored packages have SHAs saved to manifest.json. Rollout plan: staged rollout to our private customers on Dedicated and Private with alpha flag; GA after 2 weeks if no regressions. Related: SUP-7782 (support ticket for customer on RKE2+Debian), ENG-3421 (platform request for Debian support).

release_notes: Add Debian 12 (Bookworm) offline bundle support for RKE2; vendoring scripts now support apt index mirroring; rollback preserves dpkg state. See docs/onprem/offline-bundles.md for upgrade notes.
notes_for_ops: QA: run perf-canary/e2e/offline-bundles/debian_bookworm_smoke.sh against internal rke2-bookworm VM image. When rolling out to customers enable feature flag 'offline_bundle_bookworm' and monitor install success rate and rollback path. Key rotation: delegated TUF roles added; follow delegated role rotation documented in installer/offline-bundles/rke2/debian-bookworm/README.md.
security_notes: Vendored .debs include SHA256 fingerprints stored in manifest.json. TUF metadata signed with offline CI key and uploaded to internal key manager. No external mirrors are required during install; however customers must ensure allowed local apt sources when using custom mirrors.
changelog: Added: Debian Bookworm offline bundle, vendoring support for apt indices; Added: rollback-dpkg-state script; Changed: preflight apt checks now optional via values; Tests: smoke e2e job for offline bundle creation/install.
user_impact: Customers running RKE2 on Debian Bookworm can now use Redwood Private installer in air-gapped environments without internet access. Minimal configuration required; see docs for apt configuration notes.
testing_instructions: 1) Build bundle: make build-offline-bundle PROFILE=debian-bookworm 2) Run smoke VM test: .github/workflows/ci-offline-bundles.yml e2e-offline-bundle-debian target 3) Validate rollback: installer/scripts/rollback-dpkg-state.sh against test VM and assert dpkg --get-selections preserved 4) Verify TUF signatures using installer/offline-bundles/rke2/debian-bookworm/public_keys/README.md
